title: Z.A.R.V.I.S. Runtime Skill Invocation v1
description: Request and result envelope for a single skill invocation. The orchestrator validates this before dispatching to any skill executor. Approval state must be verified server-side before any mutating step executes.

invocation_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this invocation attempt.

skill_id.description: Must match a registered skill manifest ID.

skill_version.description: Must match the registered manifest version.

tenant_id.description: Platform tenant boundary. Resolved server-side from authenticated identity.

plan_id.description: Planner plan ID this invocation belongs to, if any.

input.description: Skill input, validated against skill_manifest.input_schema before dispatch.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied key. Re-running with the same key must not create duplicate side effects.

approval_token.description: Required when skill mutability is 'write'. One-time scoped approval token from the approval gate.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of invocation request.

timeout_override_seconds.description: Optional caller timeout, must not exceed manifest timeout_seconds.
